en.headline: Customs seize 8.8 kg of cannabis buds at airport in two passenger cases
en.dek: Two mainland travellers were arrested over suspected cannabis found in carry-on baggage, with cases listed for West Kowloon court on Saturday.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two drug trafficking cases involving incoming passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday and Friday, seizing a total of about 8.8 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds and 220 duty-not-paid cigarettes with an estimated market value of about HK$1.83 million.

In the first case, officers intercepted a 43-year-old mainland woman on Friday and found about 3.3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds plus the cigarettes in her carry-on baggage. She was charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug and possession of dutiable goods.

In the second case, a 41-year-old mainland man who arrived from Bangkok on Thursday was found with about 5.5 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on luggage and was charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug. Both are scheduled to appear at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Saturday.
Customs said it would continue intelligence-led enforcement against drug trafficking and reminded the public not to accept offers to carry items of unknown origin across the border.

zh.headline: 海關機場連破兩宗販毒案 檢約8.8公斤大麻花拘兩內地客
zh.dek: 兩名內地旅客手提行李藏懷疑大麻花被捕，案件周六在西九龍裁判法院提堂，估計總市值約183萬元。
body: 香港海關於周四及周五在香港國際機場偵破兩宗入境旅客販毒案件，共檢獲約8.8公斤懷疑大麻花及220支未完稅香煙，估計總市值約183萬元。
首宗案件中，海關人員周五截查一名43歲內地女旅客，在其手提行李內發現約3.3公斤懷疑大麻花及220支未完稅香煙，她被控一項販運危險藥物罪及一項管有應課稅品罪。
第二宗案件涉及一名41歲內地男旅客，他周四由曼谷抵港，清關時被發現手提行李內藏約5.5公斤懷疑大麻花，已控以販運危險藥物罪。兩人將於周六在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示會繼續根據情報加強打擊販毒活動，並呼籲市民提高警覺，切勿接受不明來源物品的運送委託。
